Reports have confirmed a deadly Hantavirus cluster aboard an international cruise ship, claiming 3 lives so far. With 147 passengers from 24 different nations already disembarking and returning to their home countries, health officials are on high alert for a potential global spread.

But the most disturbing part? This exact scenario appears to have been predicted years ago.

In this episode, we investigate:

The Cruise Ship Crisis: How a luxury voyage turned into a nightmare and the latest on the confirmed human-to-human transmission.

"The Simpsons" & The Economist: We break down the eerie "predictions" from pop culture and global magazines that have the internet spiraling. Is this a series of shocking coincidences, or something else entirely?
